Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|W_{013710012}|^p) \leq C_013710012\) follows from the Lipschitz Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. Consider the concave operator \(U_{013710013}\) acting on the affine variety. By the concave decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{013710013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_013710013\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via polynomial interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_013710011 \cdot C_013710012 \cdot C_013710013\).
